dataset.title: lobid-organisations — memory institutions in German-speaking countries

safe_field_policy.source_values_not_accessed: identifiers, organisation names/types/status, contact and web data, coordinates, source/lineage metadata and secondary locations

transformation: Outcome-blind postcode-only overlay. Read only location[0].address streetAddress/postalCode/addressLocality values; use fixed country DE; explicitly reject Postfach; parse only a strict terminal positive single house number with an optional one-letter suffix; reject every repeated semantic source identity; match an exact existing normalized base street+locality+house+suffix identity with exactly one base locality code; fill blank postcode cells only; preserve every base row and coordinate; add no source-only point.
warning: The frozen records contain identifiers, names, contact data, source lineage, secondary locations and coordinates. The overlay validates record structure but accesses only the three allowlisted main-address values and never emits source rows or source coordinates.
